what: S5 wiring: swarm change plus scope split for one new requirement (R-037) made Haiku rewrite the whole S5 split (24 tickets, old guessed file paths, duplicates), and the merge was refused for file ownership conflicts, so I wrote the single wiring ticket by hand. The worker-written e2e spec used guessed selectors (exact label Model, input id desc, cf-turnstile token not awaited) and the S4 form sent side:null that the new route schema rejects; only running the e2e against a real server found it, the route-level unit tests passed.
rule: A change order split must only create tickets for the new requirement and see the real file layout; e2e tickets need a runner step that starts the app and runs the spec; the generated client and route should share one schema.
fix: Hand-written ticket T-0163, fixed e2e selectors and Turnstile wait, client omits null side; ran e2e with a local script (build, next start, supabase env).
